title: Tame local chart with its generic transverse-section factor
statement: Let $S$ be a normal integral Noetherian quasi-separated scheme, $c:C\to S$ a quasi-compact quasi-separated smooth morphism with geometrically connected fibres, $\sigma:S\to C$ a section, and $G$ a finite group with order invertible in $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-sbc-normal-dominant-galois, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let $q:C_\eta\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$ and $j:C_\eta\to C$ exhibit the generic fibre [def-pc-fibre-product], with a section $s_\eta$ satisfying $q s_\eta=1$ and $j s_\eta=\sigma a_\eta$. Let $Z\to C_\eta$ be a finite etale $G$-torsor without any rational-point assumption. Let $U\subset S$ contain $\eta$, let $P\to C_U$ be finite etale, and let $j_U:C_\eta\to C_U$ and $\psi:Z\to P$ exhibit its generic restriction, with $i_Uj_U=j$. Let $s\notin U$ be such that every $t\notin U$ specializing to $s$ equals $s$. Put $a:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to S$, $L=C\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}$, $l:L\to C$, and let $N\to C$ be the concrete relative normalization of $P\to C_U\to C$. Let $\tau=(a\sigma,1):\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{S,s}\to L$ be the induced section. Assume $\mathcal O_{S,s}$ is a discrete valuation ring and that $n:N\times_C L\to L$ is finite. For each point $x$ of $N\times_C L$ with $n(x)=\tau(\mathfrak m_{S,s})$, put $B=\mathcal O_{N\times_C L,x}$ and $J=\mathfrak m_{L,n(x)}B$. There exist a commutative local ring $D$, a flat local homomorphism $\beta:B\to D$, an element $t\in D$, an integer $e>0$, a field $K$, a homomorphism $\operatorname{ord}:K^\times\to(\mathbb Z,+)$, a unit $\pi\in K^\times$, and a morphism $b:\operatorname{Spec}K\to\operatorname{Spec}k(S)$ such that $\mathfrak m_D=JD+(t)$, $t^e\in JD$, and $\operatorname{ord}(\pi)=1$. Moreover there is an open immersion $g:\operatorname{Spec}(K[T]/(T^e-\pi))\to Z\times_{C_\eta}\operatorname{Spec}K$, where the right-hand base change is along $s_\eta b$, and the composite of $g$ with the projection to $\operatorname{Spec}K$ is the canonical structural morphism. No root of $T^e-\pi$ is asserted.

proof.text: Minimality makes the local inverse image of U the punctured trait. Smoothness makes the closed fibre a regular effective Cartier divisor. Tameness follows from the invertible group order. Use 0EYH, localization of integral closure and its etale base change to write the concrete normalization in etale local factors R[T]/(T^e-f). Choose the factor and point over x and localize it to D. The normalization stalk map beta is local and etale, hence flat.

The etale local base maximal ideal is the extension of the original base maximal ideal. Modulo it the chosen factor is a localization of residue-field[T]/(T^e). Therefore its maximal ideal is JD+(t), and its relation gives t^e in JD. The exponent e is positive.

Pull the etale base chart back to the section and localize at the chosen point over the closed trait point. As in the proof of 0EYI this gives an unramified DVR extension A prime with fraction field K. The divisor equation f maps to a uniformizer pi, and its normalized integer valuation is one. The generic base change of the whole chart cover is the disjoint union of Spec K[T]/(T^e_i-pi). The chosen factor is thus an open (indeed clopen) subscheme of the generic section fibre of Z after extension to K. Its inclusion gives g and the structural-map identity. This construction does not use splitting of that fibre.

mathlib_searches.query: Tame local normalization charts and a transverse section over a discrete valuation ring
Tame normalization of a smooth scheme over a discrete valuation ring has local charts R[T]/(T^e-f), and their pullback to a transverse section is K[T]/(T^e-pi)
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including Scheme.Hom.normalization, fromNormalization, toNormalization, normalizationDesc, and standard smooth neighborhoods. None gives tame local charts or the transverse section generic factor.

theorem GaloisCover.stalk_normalization_trait_section_chart_generic_factor {S C : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] [IsIntegral S]
    (hS : ∀ x : S, IsIntegrallyClosed (S.presheaf.stalk x))
    (c : C ⟶ S) [QuasiCompact c] [QuasiSeparated c] [Smooth c] [GeometricallyConnected c]
    (σ : S ⟶ C) (hσ : σ ≫ c = 𝟙 S)
    (G : Type (u + 1)) [Group G] [Finite G]
    (hG : IsUnit (Nat.card G : Γ(S, ⊤)))
    {Cη : Scheme.{u}} (q : Cη ⟶ Spec S.functionField) (j : Cη ⟶ C)
    (hCη : IsPullback q j (S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S)) c)
    (sη : Spec S.functionField ⟶ Cη) (hsq : sη ≫ q = 𝟙 _)
    (hsj : sη ≫ j = S.fromSpecStalk (genericPoint S) ≫ σ)
    (Z : GaloisCover G Cη)
    (U : S.Opens) (hηU : genericPoint S ∈ U)
    (jU : Cη ⟶ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme) (PA : (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).toScheme.FiniteEtale)
    (ψ : Z.P ⟶ PA.obj.left) (hjU : jU ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι = j)
    (hψ : IsPullback ψ Z.π PA.obj.hom jU)
    (s : S) (hs : s ∉ U)
    (hmin : ∀ t : S, t ⤳ s → t ∉ U → t = s)
    (hdvr : IsDiscreteValuationRing (S.presheaf.stalk s)) :
    letI : IsFinite PA.obj.hom := PA.property
    letI : QuasiCompact (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι :=
      MorphismProperty.of_isPullback (isPullback_morphismRestrict c U)
        (inferInstance : QuasiCompact U.ι)
    let a := S.fromSpecStalk s
    let n := pullback.snd (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization (pullback.fst c a)
    let τ : Spec (S.presheaf.stalk s) ⟶ pullback c a :=
      pullback.lift (a ≫ σ) (𝟙 _) (by simp [Category.assoc, hσ])
    IsFinite n → ∀ x : (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
      (pullback.fst c a) : Scheme.{u}),
      n x = τ (IsLocalRing.closedPoint (S.presheaf.stalk s)) →
      let B := (pullback (PA.obj.hom ≫ (c ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).fromNormalization
        (pullback.fst c a)).presheaf.stalk x
      let J := (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal ((pullback c a).presheaf.stalk (n x))).map
        (n.stalkMap x).hom
      ∃ (D : CommRingCat.{u}) (_ : IsLocalRing D) (β : B →+* D),
        IsLocalHom β ∧ β.Flat ∧
        ∃ (t : D) (e : ℕ) (K : Type u) (_ : Field K)
          (ord : Kˣ →* Multiplicative ℤ) (π : Kˣ)
          (b : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ Spec S.functionField),
          0 < e ∧
          IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal D = J.map β ⊔ Ideal.span {t} ∧
          t ^ e ∈ J.map β ∧ ord π = Multiplicative.ofAdd 1 ∧
          ∃ g : Spec (CommRingCat.of
              (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ^ e - Polynomial.C (π : K)))) ⟶
              pullback Z.π (b ≫ sη),
            IsOpenImmersion g ∧
            g ≫ pullback.snd Z.π (b ≫ sη) =
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap K
                (AdjoinRoot ((Polynomial.X : Polynomial K) ^ e -
                  Polynomial.C (π : K)))))
